verdict.rationale: The CLI installs one collection into several agents at once, for example `-a claude-code -a opencode`. It lists support for OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 75+ more, and writes each agent's own `./<agent>/skills/` directory, symlinked to a single canonical copy. Per-agent targeting also works for removal (`remove --agent claude-code cursor`). Missing for 10: explicit per-harness setup instructions or docs for each agent beyond the target flags and path conventions, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-agent installs.
